WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_with_dates AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) >= DATE '2024-08-01'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) <= DATE '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) AS year,
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month,
       CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date)
           WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
           WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
       END AS month_name,
       SUM(gross_amount) AS sales_incl_vat
FROM sales_with_dates
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date)
ORDER BY month;
